# tmux option names (server, session, window and pane options); options expand in formats, e.g. #{mouse}.
# Source: tmux 3.6a man page (man tmux), OPTIONS section, every option entry from 'Available server options are:' to the HOOKS section (the set-option/show-options command entries come before it; a trailing [] array marker is dropped).
# Local package: tmux 3.6a-2ubuntu0.1.
# One name per line, sorted (LC_ALL=C) and unique. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Regenerate from the repository root (keeps these # lines, rewrites the names):
#   F=internal/integrations/tmux/testdata/tmux-option-names.txt; { sed -n '/^#/p' "$F"; zcat "$(man -w tmux)" | awk '/^Available server options are:$/{f=1;next} /^\.Sh /{f=0} f&&/^\.It (Xo )?Ic /{n=($2=="Xo")?$4:$3; sub(/\[\]$/,"",n); print n}' | LC_ALL=C sort -u; } > "$F.new" && mv "$F.new" "$F"
